meta.title: Destructure assist in function arguments doesn't respect nested structures
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#20679 (Fix complete type in nested pattern)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-08-25 and 2025-10-27; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2025-10-27. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1). These two builds cannot load a Cargo workspace with the local cargo 1.98 (--lockfile-path; attempt 1), so attempt 2 describes the crate with a rust-project.json (no cargo metadata call, no sysroot).
meta.notes: In a function parameter pattern the struct-pattern completion also appended ': Type' (the parameter's type ascription), even when the pattern is nested inside another pattern, producing 'Outer(Inner { field }: Inner)'. There is no weekly release tag between 2025-08-25 and 2025-10-27.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: the two struct declarations verbatim; the issue's placeholders '[...]' (where the user types) and '...' (the body) are replaced by the typed prefix 'Inn' and an empty body

a rust-project.json describing the single library crate (root module src/lib.rs, edition 2021, no dependencies, no sysroot); it replaces the Cargo.toml of attempt 1 because these rust-analyzer builds cannot load a Cargo workspace with the local cargo 1.98 (they pass the unstable --lockfile-path, which cargo 1.98 rejects), and the case needs no std

repro.steps: Open src/lib.rs. Request completion after 'Inn' inside 'fn stuff(Outer(Inn))' (line 5, character 18) and accept the destructuring item for Inner (label starting 'Inner {'; the plain type item 'Inner' is not the one the issue accepts). Reported: 'fn stuff(Outer(Inner { field }: Inner))', a type ascription inside a pattern; expected 'Outer(Inner { field })' (with ': Outer<Inner>' at the parameter level). Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.

attempts.summary: Cargo project (Cargo.toml scaffold), label_re '^Inner': not-reproduced-pre, but both 2025-08-25 and 2025-10-27 failed to load the workspace ('cargo metadata ... unexpected argument --lockfile-path' with the local cargo 1.98), so the struct's fields were unknown and only the plain item 'Inner' was offered and chosen ('fn stuff(Outer(Inner))' on both builds); the destructuring item the issue accepts was not offered.
